mission.name: idea-storysync-poc-complete
mission.tagline: StorySync's POC is built to the Vision Reel (PR #5) and hardened (PR #6), but 'complete at production quality' has never
mission.northStar: The Child Journey (photos, a voice per page, auto music, publish, open the link) runs end to end in a production build and every step is pinned by a test that can fail; Every merge to main crosses the full ladder plus an isolated-seat review round with no open High; Every claim below is reported at the band its evidence reached; a claim this environment cannot check is reported unverified, never proven

policies.notes: review until dogfood band 5 is routine; then auto.
